description: Use this when the user wants a posting plan drafted from a niche, posting frequency and content pillars. It is a text plan only; to put posts on the user's XcutAI calendar use xcut_add_to_calendar. Free; no sign-in. Output is generic: for work based on the user's own posts, canvases or brand, use the signed-in XcutAI tools. Do not use for writing unrelated to social media or marketing content.
